    Path toward an IPO

    Transparent by design

    Method & sources

    The model is intentionally simple. It is useful for exploring assumptions, not for manufacturing certainty.

    Core equation

    ARR×ARR multiple=Enterprise value

    Enterprise value+Net cash=Equity value

    Equity value×(1 − IPO discount)÷FD shares=Price / share

    Important limitation

    ARR multiples are shorthand. Public investors will ultimately price growth, retention, margins, cash flow, competitive durability, governance, dilution, and the market regime—not ARR alone.
